name: kit
description: Ship with confidence. Runs your rules as hooks, so Claude Code passes your project's own checks before it says done, and stops for your review after every step. Stack skills load on their own, and commands cover the work around the code: audits, ADRs and RFCs, PR reviews, your review queue, dependency PRs, incident retros and runbooks.

preset.title: Kit: preset
preset.description: A set of kit settings under one name. standard: the kit as shipped. light: fewer stops, one review per plan, no plan-critic pass, no skill nudges. strict: pattern skills required before the first edit of a file type, ASCII typography, and the claims in plans, reports, and posts checked before they go out. default: your overlay's preset, else none.

step_pause.title: Kit: step pause
step_pause.description: When Claude stops a plan for your review. step: after each step. plan: once the whole plan is done. off: never. default: your overlay, preset, or kit.yml decides.

receipt.title: Kit: gate receipt
receipt.description: When Stop and the full gate print every gate's verdict. all: on every run that checked something. failures: only when a gate failed or skipped, or the claim verifier failed. Hiding it never turns a check off, and kit explain stop shows the last one. default: your overlay, preset, or kit.yml decides.

reply_length.title: Kit: reply length
reply_length.description: Word targets for Claude's chat replies, fenced code excluded, as a plain turn and an explain one (a why, review, or opinion question). terse: 40 and 150. moderate: 100 and 300. explanatory: no target for either. A detail request (in depth, walk me through) has none. default: your overlay, preset, or kit.yml decides.

reply_slack.title: Kit: reply slack
reply_slack.description: How far past its word target a text may run when the extra words make it clearer or a fact correct, before the kit flags or sends it back: a chat reply, a write-* draft such as /write-commit, a plan, a subagent or scratch report, and a connector post. none: not at all. 25%, 50%, 100%: that share of the target more. default: your overlay, preset, or kit.yml decides.

precedence.title: Kit: rules take precedence
precedence.description: Add a system-prompt section, and a reminder on every prompt, saying the kit's rules and kit: hook context outrank default, mode, and built-in skill instructions where they conflict.

kit_stats.title: Kit: /kit-stats command
kit_stats.description: Add a /kit-stats command that prints kit stats: blocks, shadow blocks, and skips per rule, and the claims each checker flagged.

subagent_rows.title: Kit: subagent rows
subagent_rows.description: Draw each subagent row as its name with a (+N) count of agents below it, status, model, effort, context, elapsed time, and the tool it is running or its latest progress note.
